title: Rubric
description: One immutable rubric version (PRD section 13, W-02). Saving a change creates a new version; evaluations record the version they used.

completenessWeights.description: Weight per canonical field for completeness; the weights total 100.

pathwayRules.title: PathwayRules
pathwayRules.description: Thresholds read by the pathway calculator (ai/intel/scoring.py). Missing keys use the calculator defaults.

requestInfoBelowCompleteness.description: Below this completeness the pathway is request information (default 70).

highCompleteness.description: Completeness at or above this counts as complete for the quadrant (default 70).

fundingMinFeasibility.description: Strong ideas need at least this feasibility score for funding consideration (default 4).

fundingMaxLoan.description: Largest requested loan in rupees for funding consideration (default 200000).

skillingMaxReadiness.description: Readiness at or below this suggests skilling (default 2).

mentoringWeakAtOrBelow.description: A promising idea with any listed domain at or below this suggests mentoring (default 2).

mentoringWeakDomains.description: Domains checked for the mentoring rule.
